resources.role: Dataset discovery, visual reference, and comparison support
resources.capability: Interactive lunar exploration portal; inspect relevant layers and their source metadata manually
resources.plannedFeature: Discover candidate terrain and imagery products; compare contextual views
limitations: No public application endpoint is assumed
Portal views are not independent validation
Selected layers require their own provenance and usage review

resources.officialName: Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA), Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
resources.role: Terrain source for elevation, derived slope, and horizon analysis
resources.capability: Lunar laser-altimetry topography and associated terrain products
resources.plannedFeature: Local terrain sampling, slope estimation, and azimuthal horizon profiles
resources.integrationStatus: planned local dataset processing; no products downloaded
limitations: Product and resolution not yet selected
Pixel spacing is not equivalent to accuracy
Frames, projection, vertical datum, nodata, and polar coverage require product-specific checks
Instrument overview is not a terrain API

resources.officialName: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC), via NASA LRO Data Products
resources.capability: LRO product discovery page linking instrument products, including camera imagery
resources.plannedFeature: Georeferenced image context for selected sites
resources.integrationStatus: planned local imagery access; no products downloaded
limitations: The supplied page covers LRO products, not only LROC
No universal image resolution or image-service endpoint is assumed
Acquisition illumination and viewing geometry affect appearance
Imagery alone does not establish elevation or landing safety

resources.officialName: NASA Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility (NAIF) / SPICE
resources.role: Local calculation toolkit and kernel sources for time-dependent Sun and Earth geometry
resources.capability: SPICE Toolkit and ancillary kernel data for observation geometry
resources.plannedFeature: Sun and Earth directions in a documented lunar frame and local horizon frame
resources.integrationStatus: planned local computation; no toolkit or kernels installed for LunaNav
limitations: Toolkit APIs are library interfaces, not an assumed web service
Kernel coverage, lunar orientation frame, time conversion, and aberration choices must be recorded
Geometry does not include terrain blocking without a terrain model
Earth visibility does not prove radio communication

resources.role: Reference workflow for terrain mapping, profiles, visibility, and planning
resources.capability: Planetary mapping and terrain visualization workflows, including elevation profiles
resources.plannedFeature: Inform terrain-profile and planning UX; manual comparison where matching data and settings are available
limitations: No public API or automated access is assumed
Availability of a workflow is not evidence of equivalent LunaNav capability
Comparisons require matched datasets and analysis assumptions
